name: section-alignment
description: Are two sections the same block? Entity-alignment shape: one three-level score plus one noul per structural field naming the disagreement. Serves rollout block dedup and the sibling variance probe (#126).

fields.a: { page, name?, roles: ['heading','body','cta',...], repeats: [{count, uniform, unit}], counts: {headings, ctas, images, textRuns} }

instructions.question: How do `a` and `b` relate as authored blocks?
instructions.focus: Judge the rows an author would fill and how they repeat, not the words in them.

criteria.summary: Different blocks: the authored rows differ in kind — one has repeated units and the other does not, or the roles carried are different.
signals: one repeats, the other is a single composition
roles present in one are absent in the other

criteria.summary: Variants of one block: the same rows and repeat structure with a difference an option or a class would express — a different unit count, an optional CTA or image present in one, a different alignment.
signals: same roles, one optional role missing

criteria.summary: The same block: the same roles in the same order and the same repeat structure.

same_roles.instructions: Do `a` and `b` carry the same set of content roles (heading, body, cta, image, eyebrow) at the section level?

same_repeat_structure.instructions: Do `a` and `b` have the same repeat structure — both repeat units of the same composition, or neither repeats?

same_cta_pattern.instructions: Do `a` and `b` place calls to action the same way — the same number of CTAs at the same level (per unit or per section)?
